svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut 45 x 70 mm softwood to 1,020 mm, ends square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: In each end: two 9 mm holes along the length, 52 mm deep, centred in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the thickness, 20 and 50 mm up from the lower edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: In the inside face: two 10 mm cross dowel holes 30 mm deep, 40 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the end, at the same heights.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: butts between the legs on their centre line, 105 mm above the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: floor (80 mm above the foot of the leg); two M8 x 120 bolts and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cross dowels at each end. The shelf rests on its top face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: same length as the long aprons within 0.5 mm.
